projects.name: Apple Card
projects.summary: Analyzed the US credit card industry ($1.21T debt) to identify fintech growth opportunities by addressing consumer pain points like complex rewards/fees, security vulnerabilities, and exclusionary underwriting. Conducted an in-depth case study of the Apple Card, evaluating its strategy to simplify rewards/fees, enhance security, and its market impact (12M+ users, partner losses, competitive interest). Assessed competitive responses from traditional finance (e.g., Capital One/Discover merger, new card products) and concluded limited overall market disruption by the Apple Card despite user adoption.
